entities.name: David Jiříček
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: David Jiříček is a Czech professional ice hockey player who is a defenceman for the Lehigh Valley Phantoms of the American Hockey League (AHL) while under contract to the Philadelphia Flyers of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was drafted sixth overall by the Columbus Blue Jackets in the 2022 NHL entry draft.
